alerts.title: Assam floods may create short-term funding needs
alerts.detail: Businesses in affected districts with active working-capital facilities or rising utilisation may face temporary liquidity pressure.
alerts.prompt: Assam floods may disrupt working capital for 18 customers with active facilities in the affected districts. Draft the outreach plan and tell me who to call first.

alerts.title: Zepto IPO creates funding and investment conversations
alerts.detail: Employees with salary relationships, investible surplus or funding eligibility may have an upcoming IPO-related requirement.
alerts.prompt: The Zepto IPO affects 12 customers who hold salary relationships with us. Assess the ESOP funding and investment opportunities and draft the approach.

alerts.title: Gold prices have risen sharply — review jewellery merchants
alerts.detail: Higher inventory value may increase working-capital requirements and insurance exposure for selected merchants.
alerts.prompt: Gold prices have risen sharply. Assess what that means for our 9 jewellery merchants' working-capital limits and stock insurance cover.

alerts.title: Vandana Singh added her daughter to the family health cover
alerts.detail: A new dependent creates a relevant point to discuss long-term child savings and family protection planning.
alerts.prompt: Vandana Singh has added her daughter to the family health cover. Draft the child-savings and family protection conversation, including Sukanya Samriddhi eligibility.

alerts.title: Rohan Kapoor recently purchased a residential property
alerts.detail: Property ownership creates a natural point to review home protection, loan requirements and adequacy of existing life cover.
alerts.prompt: Rohan Kapoor has bought a residential property. Assess home loan, property insurance and life cover adequacy, and draft the call.

alerts.title: Meera Sethi is approaching retirement
alerts.detail: Upcoming retirement may shift priorities from accumulation towards income planning, liquidity and capital preservation.
alerts.prompt: Meera Sethi is approaching retirement. Draft an income-planning conversation covering annuities, SCSS and capital preservation.

alerts.title: Arjun Mehta promoted to VP at Orion Technologies
alerts.detail: The promotion was found on LinkedIn. The role change may indicate higher income and evolving card, investment and protection needs.
alerts.prompt: Arjun Mehta was promoted to VP at Orion Technologies. Assess the card limit, investment and protection opportunities the income change creates.

alerts.title: Nisha Verma joined a new employer as Director – Finance
alerts.detail: A recent LinkedIn job update indicates a senior move; review salary relationship, card limits and investment requirements.
alerts.prompt: Nisha Verma has joined a new employer as Director – Finance. Assess the salary-account, card limit and investment opportunities and draft the outreach.

alerts.title: Amit Khanna received ESOP liquidity following a company buyback
alerts.detail: The liquidity event may create investible surplus and tax-planning requirements beyond the customer's current relationship.
alerts.prompt: Amit Khanna has received ESOP liquidity from a company buyback. Plan the deployment of the proceeds and the capital-gains treatment.

alerts.title: Baljeet Singh Randhawa is nearing CC renewal with high utilisation
alerts.detail: Utilisation has remained elevated ahead of renewal, creating a timely opportunity to review the sanctioned limit and expected business requirement.
alerts.prompt: Baljeet Singh Randhawa's cash credit renews on 31 Oct with utilisation above 85%. Assess the limit at renewal and what to collect first.
